title_o: Google Effects on Memory: Cognitive Consequences of Having Information at Our Fingertips

replications.quote: We conclude that the original result did not replicate in the first round of data collection(p= 0.2647; point estimate in the same direc-tion as in the original study) nor in the first and second rounds of data collection pooled(p= 0.4493; point estimate in the same direc-tion as original study), given the criteria and procedure outlined above.
